text: Visitors have raised concerns about the difficulty of finding the library and the requirement to order timed tickets in advance, with some reporting confusion due to lack of clear signage or information outside the website. Several reviews noted issues with construction quality, including wood panels lifting and cracks in the rammed earth walls. There is also criticism about the absence of local North Dakota artists in the gift shop and the use of AI-generated content. Positive comments frequently mention the interactive exhibits, architecture, and views of the surrounding landscape. Some visitors noted crowding and expressed mixed feelings about the staff and food options.
